006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.regex;
007
008import java.util.regex.Pattern;
009
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011
012/**
013 * Utility methods for regular expression processing in Metapath functions.
014 */
015public final class RegexUtil {
016
017  /**
018   * Parse the regular expression flags according to
019   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#flags">the
020   * specification</a> producing a bitmask suitable for use in
021   * {@link Pattern#compile(String, int)}.
022   *
023   * @param flags
024   *          the flags to process
025   * @return the bitmask
026   */
027  public static int parseFlags(@NonNull String flags) {
028    return flags.codePoints()
029        .map(i -> characterToFlag((char) i))
030        .reduce(0, (mask, flag) -> mask | flag);
031  }
032
033  private static int characterToFlag(char ch) {
034    int retval;
035    switch (ch) {
036    case 's':
037      retval = Pattern.DOTALL;
038      break;
039    case 'm':
040      retval = Pattern.MULTILINE;
041      break;
042    case 'i':
043      retval = Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE;
044      break;
045    case 'x':
046      retval = Pattern.COMMENTS;
047      break;
048    case 'q':
049      retval = Pattern.LITERAL;
050      break;
051    default:
052      throw new RegularExpressionMetapathException(RegularExpressionMetapathException.INVALID_FLAG,
053          String.format("Invalid flag '%s'.", ch));
054    }
055    return retval;
056  }
057
058  private RegexUtil() {
059    // disable construction
060  }
061}
